version: G-3 (full-target paste floor, parent rule, window-clamped passers, all failing checks logged; 2026-10-03)

base.note: forward model A3-1 (Phase 1); no LCMGP fitting or conditioning

families.features: Ward on standardised q10..q90 of the 83 recorded blends (Phase 1 proposal, k=3, no merging needed)
families.rule: design is in family f iff its nearest recorded blend (W1, all 83) has label f and distance <= r_fam; checked at the nominal and all 10 shifted blends

conflict.residuals: saved cross-fitted bank, mean per unit; clauses (i) and (ii) only

parents.rule: G-3: candidates = recorded de-duplicated units inside the family with CS >= S* - 3 MPa AND k >= K* - 3 mm/s; parents = ALL deployable recorded passers (porosity inside 20-30 %) + farthest-point sampling (A3 standardised inputs) ONLY inside the candidate set, up to the cap 12; a family with fewer candidates than the cap uses just those (no filling with far-from-target mixes). Replaces the G-2 rule (top-24 model-score pool, farthest-point to 12).
parents.passer_rule: G-3: recorded_passer / near-passer evidence require CS >= S*, k >= K* AND recorded porosity inside the 20-30 % deployment window (S17 DEPLOY_LO/HI); window-clamped mixes are logged with phi_clamped and never count as passers or near-passer evidence
parents.failing_checks_logging: G-3: every attempt logs reject_reasons = list of ALL failing checks (order gate, family, support, paste_floor, reliability); reject_reason = first of them (G-2 field kept)

tiers.note: headline n_min = 1 (a real recorded passing unit next to the design); 2 and 3 shown beside

walk.tie_rule: stricter (lower) of lowest-index / highest-index tie rule, at nominal and all 10 shifts
walk.m_walk_basis: Phase-1 test B3: sd of LB at N=4096 is 0.0013-0.0017 at designs with LB 0.86-0.88 (0.0032 at LB 0.69), 1 sd ~ 0.002; margin is applied on top of the stricter tie rule

polish.precision: single-precision neighbour maths in the polish only (E-08); acceptance exact

paste_guard.rule: h >= h_min at the nominal blend and all 10 2 percent shifted blends; h = V_paste / (V_agg * A_ag), spheres, six-bin blend, d_k = frozen core DIAM (mm)
paste_guard.V_paste: cement/3150 + w/c*cement/1000 (no SP, no sand; = PackingPhysics_20261002/phase4.py h_ca_mm)
paste_guard.floor_rule: G-3: h_min(S*, K*) = min h over de-duplicated recorded units (631-row A3-1 data) with measured unit-mean CS >= S* AND k >= K* (full target); recomputed from the data at every start for the target and asserted equal to the frozen value. The G-2 floor (CS >= S* only, 0.1845 mm, unit 356 with K 1.05) is kept as h_min_cs_only for reporting

bootstrap.unit: study (frozen estimator; no-lab recipe_group and row variants logged only)

seeds: sha256(config_sha256|family|round|tag) mod 2^31; banks shared by all parents of a family within a round
